title: Finite reduction of the specified completed projective-line trace
statement: Let l be prime and Y,P=ProjectiveLine Y,W=diagonalSurface Y be Noetherian, with their three DiagonalTraceLocalizations. Give a completed arrow delta, a Family and a Reference to delta [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-reference]. Fix a finite intermediate field E, a maximal-ideal generator pi, and n natural; let A=ULift(O_E/(pi)^(n+1)) be finite and killed by l^(n+1), with this exponent invertible on Y. Give a quotient Diagram d and ScalarCompatibility from family.integral E to d [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars]. Give finite realizations eY,eP, a QuotientLineRealization lineP at n, and a right-derived ordinary A-module q_* model Rq identified with geoP1Pushforward by an equality q_canonical and the full IsCanonicalRightDerived unit equation. Give a FinitePushSquare from d.Rq to Rq. Give a splitting of the positive finite line shifted by two plus the constant unit whose hom is geoP1TwistedMap [sk-lem-geo-p1-cohomology]. Then eY applied to d.traceq, followed by eY.derivedUnit, is the finite square comparison followed by Rq of the lineP shifted endpoint, transport through q_canonical, and geoP1Trace for that splitting. This is only the trace equality; it assumes its models, square and splitting, and makes no assertion about d.delta.

proof.text: Transport d.traceq to the canonical finite pushforward and unit by the explicit comparison of lem-diagonal-finite-trace-chern-criterion. Apply diagonalUniformizer_traceChernDegree to identify its Chern component with the identity.

Apply finitePresentedTraceEquation_of_chern. Its complete Lean proof kills the positive shifted-line component by t-structure orthogonality, reconstructs the trace by biproduct extensionality and cancels the prescribed comparison. Hence the unchanged whole-trace equation follows from the single scalar-degree equation.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), trace reduction; source trace paragraph (1), inverse splitting and second projection
proof_origin.note: The unit component is proved by negative Ext vanishing; only degree one on the Chern summand remains as a geometric comparison. No whole splitting-reduction obligation is added.

lean.statement:
theorem diagonalUniformizer_traceReduction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)] [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (δ : diagonalCompletedDomain l Y ⟶ diagonalCompletedCodomain l Y)
    (family : Family l Y) (reference : Reference l Y δ family)
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l) (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ)
    [hfinite : Finite (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))]
    (hA : ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) = 0)
    (hYpow : IsUnit ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    (d : Diagram (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      Y (quotientLine l E π n))
    (scalar : ScalarCompatibility (quotientMap l E π n) Y
      (fun X ↦ spIntegralTwist X l E) (quotientLine l E π n)
      (quotientLineMap l E π n) (family.integral E) d)
    (eY : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) Y)
    (eP : FiniteRealization
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (lineP : QuotientLineRealization l E π n n hA (ProjectiveLine Y) eP)
    (presentation : FiniteTracePresentation
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (l ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA Y hYpow
      (quotientLine l E π n) d eY eP) :
    FinitePresentedTraceEquation
      (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n))
      (l ^ (n + 1)) (pow_pos (Fact.out : l.Prime).pos _) hA Y hYpow
      (quotientLine l E π n) d eY eP (lineP.iso l) presentation
